products.name: White Label Exchange — Swap / Convert / Buy & Sell
products.description: Your brand at the center of the exchange experience. Configure swap, convert, buy and sell journeys on the shared White Label Core. Currently a non-executing sandbox.

products.name: Crypto Payment Gateway
products.description: Bring branded crypto payment experiences into your ecosystem. Merchant checkout and payment infrastructure are planned; payment processing is not implemented.

products.name: Crypto Engine
products.description: A planned orchestration layer connecting your crypto products through one modular platform. Financial execution and provider integrations are not implemented.

products.name: iOS App
products.description: Extend your brand to a native iOS experience connected to the same White Label platform. Mobile application development is planned, not available today.

products.name: Android App
products.description: Bring your ecosystem to Android with a branded mobile experience and shared platform configuration. Mobile application development is planned.

products.name: Crypto Card
products.description: A planned branded card offering within your wider crypto ecosystem. Card issuance, spending and provider integrations are not implemented.

products.name: Staking API
products.description: A planned staking interface for future integration into your branded products. No staking engine, rewards or blockchain execution is connected.

products.name: Earn API
products.description: A planned API layer for future earning products in your ecosystem. Yield generation, balances and financial execution are not implemented.

products.name: DEX
products.description: A planned decentralized exchange experience under your brand. Smart contracts, liquidity routing and trade execution are not implemented.

products.name: Articles / Content
products.description: A planned publishing product for branded articles, education and ecosystem updates. The editorial CMS is not implemented yet.

products.name: Telegram Bot
products.description: A planned conversational entry point for your branded ecosystem on Telegram. Bot delivery and financial actions are not implemented.

products.name: Telegram Mini App
products.description: A planned compact branded experience inside Telegram, connected to the shared platform. Mini App development and integration are deferred.

products.name: WhatsApp Bot
products.description: A planned messaging channel for your branded customer experience. WhatsApp delivery and provider integrations are not implemented.

products.name: RPC / Nodes
products.description: A planned infrastructure offering for blockchain connectivity. No node hosting, RPC endpoints or live blockchain services are provided today.

products.name: Cloud Mining
products.description: A planned mining product in the modular ecosystem. Mining execution, contracts and returns are not implemented or offered.
